name: Nike Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG
description: Familiar yet always fresh, the iconic Air Jordan 1 is remastered for today's sneakerhead culture. Premium leather, responsive Air-Sole cushioning, and signature wings logo make this a timeless grail.
features: Genuine leather upper provides durability and premium structure
Encapsulated Nike Air-Sole unit in the heel for lightweight cushioning
Solid rubber outsole with deep flex grooves for traction
Perforated toe box for maximum breathability

name: Nike Air Force 1 '07
description: The radiance lives on in the Nike Air Force 1 '07, the b-ball icon that puts a fresh spin on what you know best: stitched overlays, bold accents and the perfect amount of flash to make you shine.
features: Stitched leather overlays on the upper add heritage style and durability
Originally designed for performance hoops, Nike Air cushioning adds all-day comfort
Padded, low-cut collar looks sleek and feels great
Full-length rubber outsole with pivot circles

name: Adidas Superstar
description: Originally made for basketball courts in the '70s, celebrated by hip hop royalty in the '80s, the adidas Superstar shoe is now a lifestyle staple for streetwear enthusiasts.
features: Signature ribbed rubber shell toe
Smooth leather upper with serrated 3-Stripes
Comfortable textile lining and molded sockliner
Herringbone-pattern rubber cupsole

name: Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Bred Reimagined'
description: The Air Jordan 4 delivers lightweight cushioning with a sculpted midsole designed for stability. Its retro mesh details and iconic side wings bring an authentic hardwood heritage look.
features: Full-grain premium leather upper with breathable mesh quarter panels
Visible Air-Sole unit in heel and encapsulated forefoot unit
Molded plastic eyestays and heel tab with embossed branding
Rubber outsole with multi-directional herringbone tread

name: New Balance 530
description: The 530 men's sneaker is a throwback of one of our classic running shoes. This casual kick combines everyday style with modern ABZORB cushioning for superior underfoot comfort.
features: ABZORB midsole absorbs impact through a combination of cushioning and compression resistance
Breathable mesh upper with synthetic metallic overlays
Heritage model paying homage to a 2000s running style
Adjustable lace closure for a customized fit

name: Vans Old Skool Classic
description: First known as the Vans #36, the Old Skool debuted in 1977 with a unique new addition: a random doodle drawn by founder Paul Van Doren, originally referred to as the 'jazz stripe'.
features: Iconic low-top, sidestripe shoe
Durable suede and canvas uppers
Lace-up closure and re-enforced toe caps
Signature rubber waffle outsoles

name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Hydro Black
description: Featured in our Summer Sale with 40% OFF! A springy ride for any run, the Peg's familiar, just-for-you feel returns to help you accomplish your goals with dual Zoom Air units and engineered mesh.
features: Dual Air Zoom units at the forefoot and heel for energizing transitions
Engineered mesh upper with water-repellent coating
Waffle-inspired outsole provides road traction in all weather
Plush padded tongue and collar for pressure relief

name: Puma Suede Classic XXI
description: The Suede hit the scene in 1968 and has been changing the game ever since. From Tommie Smith's podium protest to '80s b-boys in NYC, it's an undeniable culture icon.
features: Full suede upper with synthetic lining
Comfort sockliner for instant step-in cushioning
Rubber midsole and non-marking rubber outsole
Gold foil PUMA Suede callout at lateral side

name: Converse Chuck 70 Vintage High Top
description: By 1970, the Chuck evolved into the pinnacle of function and utility for sport, considered the best basketball sneaker ever. The Chuck 70 celebrates that original craftsmanship.
features: Crafted in organic 12oz canvas for premium feel and durability
Archival winged tongue stitching helps lock it in place
Vintage star ankle patch and 1970s heel license plate
Glossy egret rubber sidewall with heritage detailing

name: Nike Calm Slide Sand Drift
description: Enjoy a calm, comfortable experience wherever your day off takes you. Made from soft yet responsive foam, these lightweight slides are easy to style and pack.
features: Contoured design crafted from a single piece of soft foam
Subtle texture pattern on the footbed adds grip when wet
Full-length rubber outsole delivers durable traction
Water-friendly design dries quickly

name: Timberland 6-Inch Premium Waterproof Boot
description: When you think of Timberland boots, you're thinking of these. Our original waterproof boot was designed over 40 years ago and remains a best-seller today with tireless outdoor performance.
features: Premium waterproof Nubuck leather upper
Direct-attach, seam-sealed waterproof construction keeps feet dry
400 grams of PrimaLoft insulation for warmth
Padded leather collar for comfortable fit around the ankle

name: Nike Metcon 9 Workout Training
description: Whatever your workout looks like, the Metcon 9 makes it all worth it. Improved Hyperlift plate and added rubber rope wrap make it the gold standard for lifting and high-intensity cross training.
features: Larger Hyperlift plate in the heel for stability on tough workouts
Lace lock system attaches to shoe tongue to keep laces secured
Extended rubber wrap on the side adds durability for rope climbs
Lightweight, breathable mesh keeps feet cool
